annotations.title: Send a post to a plan (spends one run)

description: For an automation of kind per_link ("a new post each run"): the link of its next run — the new post, video or track the user wants it on. The run goes out at once as an ordinary order at the price the plan was set up with, charged from the balance (one run of the plan the user already agreed to; nothing else is charged). The link must be one the plan takes (its platform and kind: a post plan takes posts, never a profile or a token page), and each link takes one run only. Errors: not_per_link, wrong_platform / wrong_link_kind (the message says what the plan takes), link_already_used, no_runs_left, automation_ended, automation_paused. A short balance keeps the run waiting and pauses the plan until a top-up covers it; it then goes by itself.

automation.description: The automation number (the `id` of an automation, e.g. 2001).

link.description: The new post's full link, e.g. https://coinmarketcap.com/community/post/123456789.
